verdict.rationale: Undermind is positioned as an MCP server/tool that other AI clients (Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT) connect to, not as a product with its own built-in AI assistant that users delegate tasks to within Undermind itself; evidence describes it being added to external agent tools rather than an in-product assistant. missing for 10: any evidence of a native, built-in AI assistant/chat agent inside Undermind's own UI that a user can delegate tasks to.
